stem.text: A microphone is connected to a cathode-ray oscilloscope (CRO). When a tuning fork is struck and then held next to the microphone, the following waveform is shown on the display of the CRO.

stem.alt: CRO display grid with one sinusoidal waveform trace of four cycles.

stem.text: The time-base setting on the CRO is $2.00\,\text{ms}$ per division.
What is the best estimate of the frequency of the sound produced by the tuning fork?
